import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int t = sc.nextInt();

        Arrays.sort(arr);

        int max = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int count = 0;
            int j = i;
            int k = t;
            while (k >= 0 && j < n) {
                count++;
                if (j < n - 1) {
                    k -= (arr[j + 1] - arr[j]);
                }
                j++;
            }
            if (max < count) {
                max = count;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max);
        sc.close();
    }
}
